releases.displayName: Brightrock’s Next Game — Kaiju Cleanup & Studio Update

items.text: Greetings Director,

Thrilling news streaming in from the exonet Director. Video game developer Brightrock Games, who were immortalised digitally sometime in the late 21st century have announced their first new video game in several hundred years.

In partnership with Mythwright, they’ve revealed the job simulation videogame Kaiju Cleanup is coming to Steam and other platforms at some point in the next several decades, they didn’t really give a timescale.

The game seems to be about methodically deconstructing Kaiju, harvesting their parts and cleaning up the mess left behind. Frankly Director I am bristling with anticipation for a gameplay loop that can finally bring me to satisfaction.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/d637e2376f0b7f0fec2256c71da5e9e32999925c.gif"]

Given that we’ve saved the galaxy twice now we’re certainly due some R&R, check out the trailer, perhaps it’s something you’d like to pick up. Though maybe don’t share it with the consultants, Dr. Ohdious may find it a little too inspirational.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/d1abc95b8cdfe5abe3d6d5ae3492b85e4b501c16.gif"]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3729700?utm_source=SteamGC"]
If you don’t like the trailer just let me know Director and I’ll have Medi write hatemail that would make Leonard Moon want to increment his number.
Otherwise be sure to follow the developments via their prerequisite social media accounts.

notes.title: A Message from Brightrock Games & Galacticare Maintenance

items.text: Hey folks,
Thanks for checking out the announcement of Kaiju Cleanup! We and our partners at Mythwright are super excited to hear what you think, and are looking forward to sharing more over the coming months.

For those of you who’ve been with us for a while, we know this is a departure from our usual faire and might come as a bit of a surprise! After Galacticare — which was a big project for us — we wanted to try our hands at something smaller, lighter, and… messier. Looking further into the future, we’ve also got some other projects in the works, including a return to our roots deep underground.

Speaking of Galacticare, we don’t currently have any paid DLC in the works but there are a few smaller updates and bits of content in the pipes. We’ll keep you updated as these plans evolve! Overall we’re really pleased with the way Galacticare turned out, we think it helped to cement a “Brightrock” style that’s a little different, quirky and full of life and charm. It’s a rich universe that we can’t wait to explore more in the future.
Thank you to everyone who has supported Galacticare, we’ve been thrilled to deliver that story and we look forward to telling our next in Kaiju Cleanup!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3729700?utm_source=SteamGC"]
Until next time,
Brightrock Games
Greetings Directors,

As some of you might be aware, Brightrock recently signed a new multi-game partnership with us at Mythwright (ICYMI: we are now the publisher for War for the Overworld and you can read more about it here)
Today we bring more news, The Cult and Brightrock have agreed that going forward publishing will be handled by us for Galacticare.
We are excited to expand our work with the Brightrock team and are looking forward to sharing future development updates with the community!

Brace yourselves, Galacticare fans: TODAY'S THE DAY!
The new expansion is LIVE, and it's packing more chaos than a flaming Boning Chamber in the middle of an influx of urgent patients with Skeletal Trauma!

We've loaded it up with a ton of wild new features to keep you on your toes, plus a few tweaks and fixes to make sure things don't implode (unless you want them to). The galaxy burns and Galacticare is headed to the frontlines!

notes.title: "The Voice Beyond" - The Epic New Paid Expansion

items.text: In Galacticare: The Voice Beyond, saving lives is just the beginning of our monumental struggle. The CABAL has returned, unyielding and relentless, bent upon the utter destruction of all we hold dear. As the indomitable leader of Galacticare, the weight of the galaxy's survival rests upon your shoulders. You must rise to confront not only new and bizarre afflictions, like Perceptual Parapox and Rave Rash, but also the unseen saboteurs within your very hospital who plot to end your efforts from the shadows.

Victory will not be won by force of arms, but by the strength of research, the ingenuity of Medibots, and the unshakable resolve of those who rally to your cause. Will you rise to this challenge, or will all life in the galaxy fall into eternal darkness? The time to act is now!

notes.title: Exciting New Content for the DLC

items.text: 3 Thrilling, Fully Voiced Story Levels - Continue the adventure beyond the original Galacticare as you dive into new, voice-acted chapters that will test your leadership like never before!
New Events & Challenges - Brace yourself for an onslaught of new events designed to push your problem-solving and management skills to the limit.
New Rewards & Objects - Unlock a treasure trove of exciting new rewards, gadgets, and objects to aid in your mission to save the galaxy.
New Skins for Consultants and Medi - Style meets strategy with fresh new skins for your consultants and, of course, Medi. Because let's face it, everyone loves Medi!
New Sandbox Events - Enjoy the freedom of new sandbox events that will let you experiment and explore the full potential of your hospital and its resources.
Prepare for the Ultimate Challenge with Saboteurs!

Saboteurs will infiltrate your hospital, masquerading as Tenki patients, and wreak havoc on your operations. These sneaky fiends will destroy your meticulously planned toilet systems, fill your bins to overflowing, and generally make a mess of your well-oiled machines. It's up to you to root them out with ruthless efficiency. No quarter given!
New Tech: Intrusion Sensors & Security Holodrones

Defend your hospital with cutting-edge tech! Intrusion Sensors will allow you to detect these vile Saboteurs before they can do too much damage, while Security Holodrones will track them down and neutralize the threat with swift, fiery retribution.
Meet the REBEL Consultant

Introducing the ultimate wildcard: REBEL! A former CABAL agent with the uncanny ability to mimic the skills of your other consultants. Double the power, double the results! This rogue agent will give your team the edge it needs to outwit the CABAL.
Bonus: New Skins for Your Consultants (and Medi, of course)
Because no consultant should feel anything less than battle-ready, we’ve added an array of stylish new skins for your trusty team of experts and iconic characters.
Check out the new expansion for Galacticare TODAY!

But fear not, Director - we're also rolling out free updates and patches to the original game. Alongside the thrilling new narrative arc in the DLC, we've continued to fine-tune and improve everything you love about Galacticare - from the core gameplay to our nefariously hard Challenge Mode.

items.text: Greetings Director,

We’re continuing to plink away at the feedback you’ve been throwing our way. This update delivers a number of much requested Quality of Life features and many more fixes and improvements elsewhere paving a foundation for more extensive updates that we have in the works.
Added a button in the Medibot skin selection list which applies the currently-selected skin to all Medibots in the hospital
Added the ability to skip the story and unlock sandbox mode on every map
This will unlock all levels, “complete” all levels, unlock all consultants, unlock all conditions and unlock all Craftech
This will not unlock any reputation or rating rewards
This process cannot be reversed
This option can be found in the settings screen in the game tab
Added the ability to fully reset your game profile
This will reset all progress and delete all hospitals
This process cannot be reversed, so don’t use it unless you’re sure!
This option can be found in the settings screen in the game tab
Camera zoom in / out is now rebindable (PC only)
Added settings to enable or disable the default prop placement lenses (for decoration, etc)
The default value for sliders is now visually indicated on the slider

Attaining a high average mood value for patients was proving difficult due to the lack of available thoughts they had compared to staff (which also have thoughts for staff lounge capacity and their salary). To compensate, patients now receive a higher mood impact from species desires. We’ve also improved the behaviour of environment-related thoughts in unbuildable areas.
Species Desires now increase and decrease patient mood by 15% (up from 5%) - This is still only 5% for staff

Environmental thoughts (for decoration & mess) are now paused when entering a non-buildable area, instead of being removed entirely - This prevents patients entering an unbuildable area becoming arbitrarily sad without the player being able to do anything about it

We’ve improved the hospital rating system to allow us to make some per-level adjustments. As such, we’ve reduced the throughput and finances rating requirements in a few levels which were particularly tough to get a good rating in, and increased the requirements in all other levels. We’ve also made a few additional adjustments that follow some bug fixes in both 1.0.4 and 1.0.5 which made certain ratings easier to attain than intended.

Greetings Directors! We've been very very busy so this will be a big one.

Overall, we feel players are currently receiving too much income from treatments, especially when they optimise their hospitals with upgrades and consultants. We’ve lowered the base treatment income a little bit, and increased the starting amount of credits you start with to ensure the initial construction phase isn’t too punishing.
Income from treatments reduced by 12%
Starting credits increased from 75,000 to 100,000
You can no longer set staff salaries to negative amounts (regardless of how passionate they may be about their job)
Fixed fines not applying when kicking patients out of the hospital

The impact of both research and higher level doctors wasn’t being felt quite enough, so treatments are now overall a bit harder, and patients will lose more health whilst waiting - whereas doctor levels and research levels now both provide larger bonuses.
Base treatment difficulty increased from -30 to -35
Treatment bonus from doctor rank increased from +5 to +6 (per rank)
Treatment bonus from research increased from +5 to +6 (per research level)
Danger Level 1 condition health decay increased by 36%
Danger Level 2 condition health decay increased by 36%
Danger Level 3 condition health decay increased by 36%
Danger Level 4 condition health decay decreased by 2.5%

The disruptive patient spawner is responsible for disrupting your hospital, but these disruptive patient waves weren’t being felt enough once your hospital reached a certain size. This system is now slower to ramp up, but later in it will spawn larger, more dangerous waves of patients for you to deal with.
Now more likely to spawn patients with lower starting health
Minimum wave size reduced (when the hospital is small)
Maximum wave size increased (when the hospital is large)
No longer kicks in immediately when the hospital is opened in sandbox mode

Simply put, doctors were not using the Staff Lounge enough. We’ve made a round of changes to nudge them towards taking more regular breaks focused primarily on the staff lounge. Additionally, you now need to work slightly harder to keep everyone happy.
Adjusted the needs system so staff will now primarily take breaks to visit the Staff Lounge, and will make use of vending machines and toilets far less often
Characters now have a base mood of 40 (down from 50)
Patients will now make use of toilets and vending machines much more often
Patients are now more likely to use toilets and vending machines shortly after entering the hospital

We’ve made some adjustments to the hospital rating system to better balance the difficulty of each category, instead of some categories being universally much easier than others to max out. We also fixed a very impactful bug which caused decorations inside rooms to not count towards species desires.
